# ECN-2026-047: Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
The main ram bolt torque setting for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) as documented in maintenance records and operator logs requires formal correction and distribution. Current reference in the PLC configuration notes differs from the field calibration tag. This ECN standardizes the required torque for the main ram bolt to ensure clamp security, repeatable press performance, and compliance with the Heat Treat maintenance program. See related procedural and specification documents for context: SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, SOP-P1-L4-05.

Affected items
- Mechanical assembly: main ram bolt on EQ-P1-L4-HP02.  
- Maintenance documentation: torque specification entries in local equipment binder and digital maintenance records for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.  
- Operator checklists and shift handover sheets used on line P1-L4.

Implementation
- Update the torque specification for the main ram bolt on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 to 970 N·m in the equipment master file and the hardcopy equipment binder.  
- Revision of affected checklists and the EQ-P1-L4-HP02 maintenance card to reflect the updated torque. Reference SB-1034 for reporting requirements and SOP-P1-L4-02 and SOP-P1-L4-05 for procedural actions during execution.  
- Execute an initial verification by maintenance using calibrated tooling and record the confirmation on the equipment card. Enter the change into the document control system and replace the previous torque entry on the machine nameplate/tag where applicable.

Approvals
- Engineering: review and concurrence required.  
- Maintenance: acceptance of procedural steps and verification sign-off.  
- Operations: acknowledgment of updated operator guidance and checklists.

Document control note: Upon sign-off, distribute revised pages to maintenance, operations, and document control; archive superseded entries per SB-1034.
